svg.aria-label: Orrery of a multi-tenant AI platform: an LLM gateway at the centre with three assistants in orbit. Reports turns plain English into SQL and waits for an admin to confirm. Knowledge answers from each agency's own documents. Intake turns long forms into a conversation synced to the CRM. Underneath: AWS CDK, Lambda, RDS, Redis, SQS and WebSockets across three US regions.
